sourceTreeMethod: Git index tree after removing the entire product/evidence directory; reconstruct this tree from the final commit to verify source identity.

G1.details: 9 production build gates and compiled resource closure pass; current-source Mac build script prepared. No DMG generated or native signature verified.

G2.details: Actual generated desktop profile mounts standard DSH tools. Mock provider invokes real write; allow/reject/cancel and live model/persona retain PID, port and Session. Two consecutive Sessions complete; cancellation during memory retrieval never reaches LLM.

G3.details: Real source and frozen Pipecat worker startup, signaling authentication and shutdown. 3 barge-in contracts. Local WebSocket fixtures require ASR negotiation plus TTS audio. Pet lifecycle uses explicit Electron/signaling fixtures; actual microphone/audio/provider calls remain pending.

G4.details: Pinned model SHA-256 matches; frozen official ONNX encoder produces 384 dimensions and ranks Chinese preference above unrelated text (0.9032 vs 0.8288). Actual embedded PostgreSQL/retrieval/persistence are unqualified: Linux binary lacks libicuuc.so.70, root-only Work cannot setuid (EINVAL). Authenticated write/recall and cross-Session Agent injection are tested with an explicit HTTP fixture, not a database.

G5.details: Live settings preserve window/Host/Session. Only voice/memory components reconnect on relevant changes. Private DSH_HOME, inherited env protection, process shutdown, adapter restart and abort paths pass on Linux. The production provider request switches to the replacement API key without restarting the Host.

G6.details: Every Bot HTTP operation requires a token; settings bootstrap is not public, exact CORS/referrer rules, stored credentials cannot be forwarded to a new destination without replacement. Corrupt credentials preserved; screen tools default disabled. TCC remains native acceptance.

G7.details: No macOS: native ARM64 app, DMG, TCC and actual audio lifecycle must be accepted on the user Mac.

deferred.details: Old standalone Pet wake word and global keyboard/mouse pause are not migrated. Current pet uses explicit microphone and stop buttons; inactive controls are hidden, stored settings retained.

githubActions.publication: One new branch only after local checks; no matching push/create trigger, no PR/tag/dispatch/rerun/runner or Actions artifact used.
